_doc: mlcal spec for engine v5 (Calibrate B step 2): re-tune the global scales on TRAIN only (2019-2023) after the joint level pass (components.calB), with every v5 input leak-free: out-of-fold learned rates (tools/mlcal_hooks/ml_oof_v4.js), durability records + train NORM, SOS pairs, embed / preufc snapshots (tools/durrec.js, sosrec.js, mlpathrec.js inside tools/mlcal.js). inject 'overrides': only the leaves a candidate changes reach the engine, so trial 0 is the engine exactly as shipped (with 'opts' the full tree would undo v401.mlLevels off and the calB set). The knockdown / finish / stoppage levels (kdScale, kdInstant, kdRefStop, stko, gnpTko, caution5 on knockdowns) are not re-opened: on the dynamics path dyn.kdLevel3/5, convLevel and stkoScale/gnpScale carry them and the joint level pass just matched them to the 2019-2023 actuals. Run with --no-val: version selection on 2024-2025 is tools/evalv.js's single ledgered look.
